Hi Alicia —

Great to meet you on the call this morning. Thanks for the clear context on ACME Bio's latency targets for batch inference and the compliance constraints for on-prem data handling. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: primary goals are predictable sub-200ms p95 latency for <1k qps traffic, and a private deployment option for PHI-laden workloads.
- Risks we flagged: procurement timeline, on-prem networking details, and whether the CTO wants a technical deep dive before pricing commitment.

Proposed next steps:
1) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO intro) to confirm success metrics and decision criteria — 30 min
2) Technical deep dive/demo (solutions + infra) — 60 min, with your CTO and our infra lead
3) Share mutual action plan + draft commercial terms

I've attached a short intro deck and a one-pager mutual action plan to help frame the exec call. Are you able to introduce your VP/CTO for a 30-min alignment next week? If helpful, I can propose a few time options.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
